summary: P4 Chinese Financial NLP Layer — 8 features across 4 execution waves: Foundation (NER + Lexicon), Core NLP (Announcement Parser + Sentiment Classifier + Event Extractor), Advanced (Report Summarizer + Policy Understander), Integration (P3 Event Engine connectors)
approach: Layered NLP architecture: Wave 1 builds foundation (NER engine + sentiment lexicon), Wave 2 builds core NLP tasks that consume foundation, Wave 3 builds advanced analysis on core NLP, Wave 4 integrates all NLP outputs into P3 event engine via BaseDetector ABC. All NLP modules in synapse/nlp/ package, integration via synapse/event/nlp_detectors.py. All frozen dataclasses use frozen=True, slots=True. All tests use py -m pytest -p no:asyncio.
recommended_execution: Phased — 4 waves with parallel tasks within each wave
